Category.description: Category and subcategory for the event date.

TicketsMarkedAsSold.description: Tickets marked as sold (Assigned Seating only).

TicketsOnHold.description: Tickets on hold (includes holds and consignment).

Capacity.description: Capacity and ticket sales summary for the event date. Only present when includeCapacity=true.

Date.description: The date where the event takes place (local time)

DateDisplay.description: Custom text overriding the default displayed date/time for this event date (Datumsanzeige)

DateLabel.description: Short custom label/tag for this event date, e.g. for venue changes or notices (Datumsbezeichnung)

DateLabelColor.description: Hex color associated with the date label, used on the online event calendar

DoorsOpen.description: The event date duration in hours

EventDateID.description: Numeric id of the event date

EventDateName.description: A custom name for the event date

EventDateStatus.description:
Status of the event date 
Online | Offline

EventDuration.description: The event date duration in hours

EventID.description: Numeric foreign key to an event

EventPicture.description: Picture overwrite for the event date

IsActive.description: The Show Online toggle in Event Manager. Same value as ShowOnline, retained for backward compatibility.

ShowOnline.description: The Show Online toggle in Event Manager

UniqueID.description: Unique ID used to identify the event date

Venue.description: Inforamtion about the venue the event takes place in

CategoryID.description: The category id of the event (categories can be looked up in the event manager)

CategoryName.description: The category name of the event

Date.description: Date when the event takes place (local time)

End.description: Date when the event ends (local time)

EventDates.description: A collection of event dates associated with the event.

EventIntro.description: A short description for the event

IsBoxOfficeOnly.description: Indicates whether the event is restricted to Box Office sales only

IsPrivate.description: Indicates whether the event is marked private and hidden from public event listings

PriceRange.description: Price range separated by a ":" symbol. (May be overwritten to contain a custom text)

Start.description: Date when the event starts (local time)

SubCategoryID.description: The sub category id of the event (categories can be looked up in the event manager)

SubCategoryName.description: The subcategory name of the event

UniqueID.description: Unique ID used to identify the event

IsRefund.description: True when the line is a refund (RefundReceiptID > 0) or a cancelled line (Qty 0, Option1/Value1 = Cancelled)

info.description:
# Information

This is a general documentation for the VBO public API. 

THIS API IS SUBJECT TO UNANNOUNCED ADDITIONS OF OBJECTS/FIELDS. WE DO NOT MODIFY/DELETE EXISTING FIELDS UNANNOUNCED.

# Authorization
<SecurityDefinitions />

# Webhooks

Webhooks can be configured using the Setup > Add-Ons > Webhooks area in the eventmanager.
We recommend to validate the webhooks signature in the SecretHash header using your api secret.

It is designed as a push/pull api, meaning that the webhook payload will contain a resource identifier which can be used to subsequently query the required resource.
## Webhook example
    {
        "UniqueTicketID": "13927245-5f00-42e9-aec2-f906099e0e49"
    }

## Available webhooks
Payload id in parenthesis.
- order.sale (UniqueOrderID, SalesReceiptID)
- order.refund (UniqueOrderID, RefundReceiptID)
- order.cancelled (UniqueOrderID)
- event.created (UniqueEventID)
- event.modified (UniqueEventID)
- event.deleted (UniqueEventID)
- eventdate.created (UniqueEventDateID)
- eventdate.modified (UniqueEventDateID)
- eventdate.deleted (UniqueEventDateID)
- ticket.scanned (UniqueTicketID; also includes ItemName, ItemCat, Option1-3, Value1-3)
- ticketuser.modified (UniqueTicketID)
